This is a personal finance book centered on action. In today’s climate of soaring inflation, rising prices are eroding the value of cash and savings. If individuals still hold on to large amounts of cash without building assets, they may find themselves on shaky ground amid powerful economic shifts. The only way forward is to persist and confront the challenge head-on. Whether you're accumulating assets or launching a business, taking action is no longer optional—it’s essential. So, what is the key to taking successful financial action? Is it knowledge, luck, or capital? While these factors can certainly help, they are not always within our control. Persistence, however, is something you can choose and take charge of. In fact, it is the most crucial factor in determining the success or failure of your financial journey
